get_config_hn: get the default FermiNet configuration for a 1D hydrogen chain simulation
set_geometry_hn: set the molecular geometry for a hydrogen chain with configurable bond length and atom count
run_hn_simulation: run a FermiNet quantum chemistry simulation on a 1D hydrogen chain using the default config
modify_hn_bond_length: modify the hydrogen chain bond length in the FermiNet configuration before running
review_hn_config: review the FermiNet hydrogen chain configuration to inspect atom positions and electron counts
